name: Maria Fini
abstract_title: Evidence of multiplicity in the subconscious mind from Internal Family Systems therapy and dissociative identity disorder
abstract: Contemporary neuroscience often treats the mind as a unified cognitive agent emerging from distributed neural activity, yet this view struggles to account for the heterogeneity, conflict, and internal contradiction inherent in human experience. authors: Maria Fini, Paul Seli, Jonathan Schooler, Justin Riddle
field: Internal Family Systems therapy, subconscious multiplicity
